lines.personal_line: We have great respect for the way your team looks after customers in pharmacies they rely on every day. Your customers include people who are cutting down on sugar, and we believe sugar free sweets and snacks may suit those very same customers. We would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss whether this could be a worthwhile addition to your range.
